description: Search dorm / back-to-school essentials. Returns Amazon search deep-links (and optional catalog matches). marketplace + locale are REQUIRED. Until real Associates IDs exist, links omit ?tag= (tagConfigured=false).

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for the shopper (e.g. en-US, sv-SE). REQUIRED.

marketplace.description: Amazon marketplace id (e.g. us, se) or domain (e.g. amazon.com, amazon.se). REQUIRED.

q.description: Search query, e.g. desk lamp or twin XL sheets

name: search_kit_items
title: Search dorm kit items
